"""Publish compact Xe update evidence at a closed preflight or model boundary."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-latest-updates-20261012')
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-xe-b9-update'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('xe_b9_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s)
s.loader.exec_module(m)
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--phase', choices=['preflight','final'], required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi',
           LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -oBatchMode=yes')
ruby = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())
for key in ['RUBYLIB','GEM_PATH']:
    ENV[key] = ruby['environment'][key]

def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')

def public_hashes(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k:({'sha256':v} if k.endswith('/tokens.css') and isinstance(v,str) and len(v)==64
                   else public_hashes(v)) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value,list):
        return [public_hashes(v) for v in value]
    return value

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / ('main-current-xe-b9-' + args.phase + '-publication-root-v1')
    m.require(not out.exists(), 'fresh publication')
    out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], evidence={},
             controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__), started_utc=m.utc(), gpu_executed=False,
             model_executed=False, phase=args.phase)
    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
                             rss_cap=8 << 30, text_cap=32 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        m.require(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label)
        return so.read_text().strip()
    try:
        full = json.loads((B / 'main-current-update-replica-full-root-v2/record.json').read_text())
        m.require(full['passed'] and all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p,h in full['source_pins'].items()), 'qualified server source unchanged')
        m.require(not run('local-identity', ['git','config','--local','--get-regexp',r'^user\.(name|email)$'],(1,)), 'global identity only')
        run('author-identity', ['git','var','GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        if args.phase == 'preflight':
            m.require(not F.exists(), 'fresh report boundary')
            F.mkdir()
            reports = ['research-xe-b9-single-device-safety-round306-v1.txt',
                       'research-xe-b9-setup-upstream-coverage-round307-v1.txt',
                       'research-xe-b9-segmented-serve-route-round308-v1.txt',
                       'implementation-xe-b9-pristine-controller-source-v1.txt']
            entries = []
            for name in reports:
                p = B / 'research-20261009' / name
                target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
                dump(target,dict(original_path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size,text=p.read_text()))
                entries.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)),sha256=m.sha(target)))
            prior = F.parent / '2026-10-12-upstream-replica-server/report-registry-v173.json'
            index = json.loads(prior.read_text())
            dump(F / 'report-registry-v174.json',dict(research_completed=index['research_completed']+len(entries),
                prior=dict(path='../2026-10-12-upstream-replica-server/report-registry-v173.json',sha256=m.sha(prior)),
                new_reports=entries,main_only_test_execution=True,
                main_adjustments=['R306 unrestricted one-shot/session polling concern is bounded by R308 actual segmented serve call trace.',
                    'R307 watchdog false-idle concern already handled: Main telemetry provider reports zero/missing/stale as unknown; observational only.',
                    'One selected Intel Level Zero GPU does not imply the host has only one physical GPU.',
                    'New Xe HEAD is b9f00e9, xe0.1.43 development source; previous da3d426 diagnostic is historical.']))
            for directory in ['main-current-xe-b9-controller-source-v1','main-current-xe-b9-controller-source-v2']:
                for p in sorted((B / directory).iterdir()):
                    if p.is_file():
                        if p.suffix == '.json':
                            content = public_hashes(json.loads(p.read_text()))
                            dump(F/'controllers'/directory/(p.name+'.json'),dict(original_path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size,content=content))
                        else:
                            dump(F/'controllers'/directory/(p.name+'.json'),dict(original_path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size,text=p.read_text()))
            roots = ['main-current-xe-b9-fetch-root-v1','main-current-xe-b9-xe-free-build-root-v1',
                     'main-current-xe-b9-xe-contrib-llvm-build-root-v1','main-current-xe-b9-host-tests-root-v1',
                     'main-current-xe-b9-controller-cpu-root-v1','main-current-xe-b9-admission-root-v1']
            derivations = []
            for name in roots:
                p = B/name/'record.json';v=json.loads(p.read_text())
                m.require(v['passed'] and v['complete'] and not v['active'],'closed receipt '+name)
                public = dict(v)
                if name.endswith('host-tests-root-v1'):
                    public['evidence'] = {k:z for k,z in v['evidence'].items() if k.endswith('ctest-host')}
                else:
                    public.pop('evidence',None);public.pop('command_evidence',None)
                target = F/'receipts'/(name+'.json');dump(target,public_hashes(public))
                derivations.append(dict(original_path=str(p),original_sha256=m.sha(p),original_bytes=p.stat().st_size,
                    public_path=str(target.relative_to(F)),public_sha256=m.sha(target),
                    removed='duplicate successful command stdout/stderr; source/commands/environment/status/owner closure preserved; all CTest outcomes retained'))
            for p in sorted((B/'main-current-xe-b9-admission-root-v1').glob('*.json')):
                if p.name!='record.json':
                    dump(F/'admission'/p.name,public_hashes(json.loads(p.read_text())))
            stale = B/'main-current-update-final-verify-root-v1/record.json'
            value=json.loads(stale.read_text())
            m.require(all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0 for c in value['commands']),'closed final head check commands')
            dump(F/'remote-advance.json',dict(original_path=str(stale),original_sha256=m.sha(stale),
                original_status={k:value.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','active']},
                interpretation='Final remote equality check aborted when Xe HEAD became b9f00e9. Original flags remain unchanged; every owned command closed; not a GPU failure.',
                evidence=value['evidence'],source_equivalence_files=value['source_equivalence_files']))
            dump(F/'receipt-derivations.json',dict(receipts=derivations,private_receipts_retained_for='Exact qualification/source/library identity consumers until model boundary; review before retirement.'))
            text="""<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# XeStrata update observed during finalization

XeStrata advanced from da3d426 to b9f00e9 while Main finalized the official
v0.1.43 server imports. The new tree calls itself xe0.1.43 and integrates official
7695859. It changes 148 files, including SYCL kernels, memory, models and benchmark
setup. It is fetched into an independent ghq worktree with no tracked source
patch. The official selective server ports are already committed at 17879c7.

Both free and contrib-llvm inference executables build with the qualified source
LLVM provider. Each mode runs nine selected host CTests: eight pass and the
existing AVX-512-only expert_multi_test skips on this Ryzen 5600X. IQ3/other native
AVX2 parity, Q8_K quantization, Q2 bit-plane and pool partition tests pass.
The retargeted diagnostic controller passes malformed protocol, owner/QUIT,
pending-admission and pending-process CPU fixtures. No GPU/model operation has
run for this new revision at this preflight boundary.

R306 identifies non-atomic mapped-word polling in unrestricted one-shot session
execution. Main and R308 follow the actual ordinary serve route: forced segmented
verification waits for compute completion before CPU reads and for copies before
the next launch. The one-shot loop is below the serve return. Resident graphs,
the new interop copy engine, prompt issuer and CPU prompt sharing are disabled;
MTP, batches and pipelines are excluded. This is a bounded source admission,
not a whole-engine portable safety or runtime performance claim.

The next controlled diagnostic keeps the prior 32768-input/16-output recipe,
8192 prompt chunks, cache128, workers5 and PCIe fraction0. Requested settings and
actual READY/INFO/PP values will be recorded separately. Level Zero validation
and progress logging remain enabled. The setup-default recipe and a parameter
search are separate work: neither this diagnostic nor the old official serial
windows8 samples establish a tuned comparison. Full physical262144 input,
RESTORE, full-vocabulary parity and task quality remain open.

The original reports, source-only proposal, Main derivative, exact source and
ELF/compiler/library pins, commands, environment and individual CPU outcomes
are preserved here. Fresh same-provider GPU health, kernel/dump checks and normal
QUIT are required before and after any model attempt. No reset or service change
is authorized by this diagnostic.
"""
            (F/'REPORT.md').write_text(text)
        for p in sorted(B.glob('main-current-xe-b9-*.py')):
            data=p.read_bytes()
            dump(F/'controllers'/(p.name+'.json'),dict(original_path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=len(data),text=data.decode()))
        files=[str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
        lint=run('report-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files])
        m.require('skipped (' not in lint,'all report lints available')
        run('diff-check',['git','diff','--check','HEAD'])
        run('stage-evidence',['git','add','--',str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit-evidence',['git','commit','-m','chore(bench): qualify pristine Xe v0.1.43 update '+args.phase])
        r['commit']=run('committed-head',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'])
        run('push-evidence',['git','push','-u','origin','sync/latest-updates-20261012'])
        m.require(not run('final-status',['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all']),'clean final worktree')
        r.update(passed=True,complete=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error']=repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','error','commit']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
